preconditions.description: The length of the array n is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each element a_i in the array a is between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or (isinstance(return_value, list) and all(isinstance(pair, tuple) and len(pair) == 2 and 1 <= pair[0] < pair[1] <= n for pair in return_value))
postconditions.description: The output is either '-1' or a list of tuples, where each tuple contains two integers u and v such that 1 <= u < v <= n.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or all(a[u-1] > a[v-1] for u, v in return_value)
postconditions.description: If the output is not '-1', each pair (u, v) in the list is an inversion in the array a.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or len(return_value) == len([1 for u in range(n) for v in range(u+1, n) if a[u] > a[v]])
postconditions.description: If the output is not '-1', the list contains all inversions in the array a.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or sorted(a) == [a[i] for i in range(n) if all(a[i] <= a[j] for j in range(i+1, n))]
postconditions.description: If the output is not '-1', applying the swaps in the list results in the array a being sorted in non-decreasing order.
